subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should relational oc-path predicates preserve finite `Number()`-style numeric acceptance, or intentionally adopt the narrower plain-decimal grammar proposed here?
rationale: This is a user-visible query-language compatibility choice, not a mechanical bug repair: the branch rejects previously finite numeric forms such as exponent notation.

options.title: Preserve finite numeric predicates
options.body: Keep the existing finite-number acceptance and narrowly address only coercions that maintainers explicitly consider invalid.

options.title: Adopt strict decimal predicates
options.body: Approve the new grammar deliberately, document the rejected forms, and add compatibility-focused tests and real CLI evidence.

options.title: Pause for grammar direction
options.body: Leave the PR open until an owner chooses the supported public predicate syntax.

recommendation.title: Preserve finite numeric predicates
recommendation.body: Keep the existing finite-number acceptance and narrowly address only coercions that maintainers explicitly consider invalid.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed participant in the supplied timeline who can be routed for the unresolved grammar decision.
